subject: PE
title: PE 5
description: Fifth-grade physical education that refines throwing, catching, dribbling, striking and rhythmic movement skills through lead-up games for soccer, flying disc, basketball, volleyball and softball, plus jump rope and folk dance. Fifth grade is a California Physical Fitness Test (FITNESSGRAM) year, so the course opens with a baseline fitness check, teaches the components of health-related fitness and heart-rate monitoring, and closes with a personal fitness plan and post-test. Every week includes a warm-up and cool-down, skill practice with critical cues, a game or challenge, and a sportsmanship focus; most activities need only a backyard, park or driveway.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards (2005); 2009 California Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-5.1.1: Perform a teacher- or student-designed rhythmic routine with correct response to simple rhythms.
standards.PE-5.1.2: Jump rope combining a variety of tricks and footwork patterns, individually and with a long rope.
standards.PE-5.1.3: Throw overhand to a moving partner or target with accuracy and appropriate force.
standards.PE-5.1.4: Catch a thrown object while moving and immediately transition to a throw or pass.
standards.PE-5.1.5: Throw a flying disc with accuracy for distance using backhand technique.
standards.PE-5.1.6: Hand-dribble while changing speed and direction and while guarded by an opponent.
standards.PE-5.1.7: Foot-dribble and pass a ball to a moving partner using the inside and outside of the foot.
standards.PE-5.1.8: Strike an object with a paddle or racket using forehand and backhand strokes.
standards.PE-5.1.9: Volley a ball using the forearm pass and overhead set to a target or partner.
standards.PE-5.1.10: Strike a pitched or tossed ball with a bat using correct grip, stance and follow-through.
standards.PE-5.1.11: Kick, trap and punt a ball with control for distance and accuracy.
standards.PE-5.1.12: Combine locomotor and manipulative skills in modified game situations.
standards.PE-5.2.1: Explain and apply offensive and defensive strategies such as creating and denying open space.
standards.PE-5.2.2: Explain how force, angle of release and follow-through affect distance and accuracy.
standards.PE-5.2.3: Analyze a skill using its critical elements and provide feedback to self and others to improve performance.
standards.PE-5.2.4: Explain how rhythm, tempo and patterns are used to design movement sequences and dances.
standards.PE-5.3.1: Participate in appropriate warm-up and cool-down exercises for specific physical activities.
standards.PE-5.3.2: Engage in moderate-to-vigorous physical activity for increasing periods to build aerobic capacity.
standards.PE-5.3.3: Improve muscular strength and endurance through exercises such as curl-ups and push-ups.
standards.PE-5.3.4: Improve flexibility through regular stretching (shoulder stretch, sit-and-reach, trunk lift).
standards.PE-5.3.5: Assess health-related fitness and work toward the age-appropriate Healthy Fitness Zone.
standards.PE-5.3.6: Monitor and log physical activity done outside of school toward 60 minutes daily.
standards.PE-5.4.1: Identify and define the five components of health-related fitness.
standards.PE-5.4.2: Measure heart rate before, during and after activity and explain the effect of exercise on the heart.
standards.PE-5.4.3: Develop and monitor a personal fitness goal and plan based on fitness assessment results.
standards.PE-5.4.4: Explain the FITT principle (frequency, intensity, time, type) for improving fitness.
standards.PE-5.4.5: Explain the role of hydration and nutrition in physical activity.
standards.PE-5.5.1: Cooperate and include others of all skill levels in group activities.
standards.PE-5.5.2: Demonstrate good sportsmanship and resolve conflicts respectfully during games.
standards.PE-5.5.3: Follow safety rules and use equipment safely.
standards.PE-5.5.4: Encourage and give constructive feedback to others.

units.title: Fitness Foundations and Baseline Assessment
units.big_idea: Knowing the components of fitness and where you start lets you set meaningful goals.

units.title: Jump Rope and Locomotor Rhythms
units.big_idea: Rhythm and timing connect footwork, jump rope tricks and heart health.

units.title: Soccer Skills and Invasion Games
units.big_idea: Ball control and open space help a team keep possession and score.

units.title: Throwing, Catching and Flying Disc
units.big_idea: Accurate throws depend on stepping, rotating and following through toward the target.

units.title: Basketball Skills
units.big_idea: Dribbling with control and passing to open teammates make the offense work.

units.title: Folk and Cultural Dance
units.big_idea: Dances from many cultures use patterns, rhythm and cooperation to tell stories and celebrate.

units.title: Net and Wall Games: Volleyball and Paddle Skills
units.big_idea: Controlling force and angle sends the ball where the opponent is not.

units.title: Striking and Fielding: Softball and Kickball
units.big_idea: Batting, fielding and base running combine skills with quick decisions.

units.title: Personal Fitness Plan and Post-Assessment
units.big_idea: A personal plan using the FITT principle turns fitness into a lifelong habit.

weeks.topic: Warm-ups, safety and the five components of fitness
objectives: Perform a dynamic warm-up and static cool-down
Name the five components of health-related fitness

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn a 5-minute dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, arm circles, lunges, skips) and play a tag game.

days.title: Components of fitness
days.work: Do one station for each fitness component (jog, push-ups, plank, stretch) and match each to its definition.

days.title: Safety and space
days.work: Set up a safe activity area, review safety rules and play 'Sharks and Minnows' using space awareness.

days.title: Cool-down
days.work: Learn a static stretching cool-down for major muscle groups after a 10-minute jog-walk.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Lead the warm-up for a family member and explain the five components of fitness.

weeks.assessment: Student-led warm-up and oral check of fitness components.

objectives: Measure resting and active heart rate
Begin PACER or mile run practice

days.title: Finding a pulse
days.work: Find your pulse at wrist and neck and count resting heart rate for 15 seconds x 4.

days.title: Heart rate experiment
days.work: Measure heart rate after walking, jogging and sprinting for 1 minute each and graph the results.

days.title: PACER practice
days.work: Practice the 20-meter PACER shuttle run with pacing strategy for 10 minutes.

days.title: Steady pace jog
days.work: Jog-walk a measured quarter mile four times, trying to hold an even pace.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain to a parent why heart rate increases with exercise and record a heart rate chart.

objectives: Perform curl-ups, push-ups and trunk lifts with correct form
Practice sit-and-reach and shoulder stretch

days.title: Curl-up form
days.work: Learn FITNESSGRAM curl-up form with a cadence and practice 3 sets.

days.title: Push-up form
days.work: Learn the 90-degree push-up and practice with modified versions (wall, knee) to build up.

days.title: Trunk lift and flexibility
days.work: Practice the trunk lift and back-saver sit-and-reach and shoulder stretch with correct technique.

days.title: Strength circuit
days.work: Complete a 6-station circuit (squats, planks, curl-ups, push-ups, wall sit, lunges) 30 seconds each.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Watch a partner perform each test and give feedback on form using a checklist.

weeks.assessment: Form checklist for each fitness test item.

objectives: Complete baseline fitness tests
Compare results to the Healthy Fitness Zone

days.title: Aerobic test
days.work: Complete the PACER (or one-mile run) and record laps or time.

days.title: Strength tests
days.work: Complete the curl-up and push-up tests and record scores.

days.title: Flexibility tests
days.work: Complete the trunk lift and sit-and-reach and record scores.

days.title: Comparing to HFZ
days.work: Compare your scores to the Healthy Fitness Zone chart for your age and highlight strengths and areas to improve.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write one fitness goal for the year and an activity to support it, then play an active game of choice.

weeks.assessment: Baseline FITNESSGRAM score sheet and goal statement.

objectives: Jump rope with basic and alternate foot steps
Monitor heart rate during jump rope

days.title: Rope basics
days.work: Size the rope and practice the basic bounce and alternate step for 3 x 1-minute sets.

days.title: Footwork tricks
days.work: Learn skier, bell and side-straddle tricks and practice each 20 times.

days.title: Jumping to music
days.work: Jump to a song with a steady beat, changing tricks every 8 counts.

days.title: Heart rate check
days.work: Measure heart rate after 2 minutes of continuous jumping and compare to jogging.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a 30-second trick sequence and count successful jumps in 1 minute.

weeks.assessment: Jump rope trick checklist and 1-minute count.

weeks.topic: Advanced rope tricks and long rope
objectives: Perform crosses, double unders (attempt) and side swings
Enter and exit a long rope

days.title: Criss-cross
days.work: Learn the criss-cross and side swing open, practicing with feedback cues.

days.title: Double under attempts
days.work: Practice high jumps with fast wrists to attempt double unders.

days.title: Long rope
days.work: With two turners (family or a tree tie-off), practice entering, jumping 10 and exiting a long rope.

days.title: Peer coaching
days.work: Coach a family member on one trick using critical cues and encouragement.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform 5 different tricks and record which ones you mastered.

objectives: Combine locomotor movements to a rhythm
Design a movement sequence
materials: lummi sticks or rhythm sticks (or wooden spoons)

days.title: Locomotor review
days.work: Practice skip, slide, gallop, leap and hop to changing music tempos.

days.title: Rhythm sticks
days.work: Learn a lummi stick routine in 4/4 time with a partner.

days.title: 8-count sequences
days.work: Combine four 8-count locomotor sequences into one pattern.

days.title: Designing a routine
days.work: Design a 32-count routine mixing locomotor moves and jump rope tricks.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the routine to music and explain how it follows the beat.

weeks.topic: Jump rope routine and unit assessment
objectives: Perform a jump rope routine to music
Give constructive feedback

days.title: Routine planning
days.work: Plan a 1-minute jump rope routine with at least 6 tricks and transitions.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice the routine with music, focusing on staying on beat.

days.title: Record and review
days.work: Record the routine and identify two spots to improve.

days.title: Jump-a-thon
days.work: Do a family 'Jump Rope for Heart' style challenge, counting total minutes jumped.

days.title: Unit 2 assessment
days.work: Perform the routine for an audience and give feedback on another performer's routine.

weeks.topic: Dribbling and ball control with feet
objectives: Dribble with inside and outside of the foot
Change speed and direction with control

days.title: Close control
days.work: Dribble through a cone line using small touches with both feet.

days.title: Changing direction
days.work: Practice inside and outside cuts around cones and a figure-8 pattern.

days.title: Speed dribbling
days.work: Dribble 20 m at speed with longer touches and stop the ball with the sole.

days.title: Dribble tag
days.work: Play dribble tag where players must keep control while avoiding a tagger.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a timed cone dribble course twice and compare times and control.

weeks.assessment: Cone course time and control checklist.

objectives: Pass with the inside of the foot to a moving partner
Trap the ball to control it

days.title: Push pass
days.work: Practice the inside-of-foot push pass against a wall 50 times, alternating feet.

days.title: Trapping
days.work: Trap passes with the sole, inside of foot and thigh, then pass back.

days.title: Passing gates
days.work: Pass through cone gates to a partner, scoring a point for each gate.

days.title: Lead passes
days.work: Pass ahead of a moving partner so they receive the ball in stride.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Analyze a partner's pass using cues (plant foot, ankle locked, follow-through) and give feedback.

weeks.assessment: Passing gates score and peer feedback form.

objectives: Shoot with the instep
Punt and catch as a goalkeeper

days.title: Instep shot
days.work: Practice the instep drive at a goal from 10 m, aiming for corners.

days.title: Punting
days.work: Practice punting for distance and height, measuring the best of 5.

days.title: Goalkeeping
days.work: Practice the W catch and scoop as a partner shoots gently.

days.title: Shooting game
days.work: Play a 1-v-1 shooting game, rotating goalkeeper.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Shoot 10 times at target zones and record accuracy.

objectives: Create open space on offense
Mark and deny space on defense

days.title: Keep-away
days.work: Play 2-v-1 keep-away and discuss how to move to open space.

days.title: Defense
days.work: Practice marking a player and staying goal-side in 1-v-1 drills.

days.title: Small-sided game
days.work: Play 2-v-2 or 3-v-3 soccer (family or park) applying offensive and defensive strategies.

days.title: Sportsmanship
days.work: Play a game where players self-officiate and resolve disputes with rock-paper-scissors.

days.title: Unit 3 assessment
days.work: Play a game while a parent uses a skills and strategy checklist, then reflect on sportsmanship.

weeks.topic: Overhand throwing for accuracy and distance
objectives: Use correct overhand throwing mechanics
Explain how force and angle affect distance

days.title: Throwing cues
days.work: Practice the overhand throw cues (side to target, step with opposite foot, rotate, follow through) at a wall target.

days.title: Distance throws
days.work: Throw for distance at 3 different release angles and measure to find the best angle.

days.title: Accuracy targets
days.work: Throw at targets from 5, 10 and 15 m and record hits.

days.title: Video analysis
days.work: Record your throw in slow motion and compare to the cues.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain in writing how force and angle affected your distance results.

objectives: Catch while moving and transition to a throw
Lead a moving receiver

days.title: Target hands
days.work: Practice catching above and below the waist with proper hand position.

days.title: Moving catches
days.work: Run routes (slant, out, curl) and catch passes from a partner.

days.title: Catch and throw
days.work: Catch on the move and immediately throw to a second partner or target.

days.title: Team passing game
days.work: Play 'Ultimate ball' (no running with the ball) with teammates of all skill levels.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete 10 moving catches and record success rate.

objectives: Throw a backhand with accuracy
Catch a disc with pancake and rim catches

days.title: Backhand throw
days.work: Practice the backhand grip, stance and wrist snap with short throws.

days.title: Catching
days.work: Practice pancake and rim catches at different heights.

days.title: Accuracy
days.work: Throw through a hula hoop target from increasing distances.

days.title: Disc golf
days.work: Set up a 6-hole backyard or park disc golf course and play a round, counting throws.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how angle of the disc affects its flight and demonstrate a straight throw.

objectives: Apply throwing and catching in Ultimate
Include and encourage all players

days.title: Pivoting
days.work: Practice pivoting and faking before throwing to a partner.

days.title: Ultimate rules
days.work: Learn modified Ultimate rules and the 'spirit of the game' self-officiating tradition.

days.title: Game play
days.work: Play a small-sided Ultimate game with family or friends.

days.title: Including everyone
days.work: Play a version where every player must touch the disc before scoring.

days.title: Unit 4 assessment
days.work: Complete a throwing/catching skills test and write about how you showed spirit of the game.

objectives: Dribble with either hand while changing speed and direction
Protect the ball from a defender

days.title: Stationary dribbling
days.work: Do ball-handling drills (pound, low, crossover, around the leg) for 1 minute each.

days.title: Moving dribble
days.work: Dribble through cones with the right hand, left hand and crossover at each cone.

days.title: Speed and control
days.work: Alternate speed dribbles and control dribbles on a whistle.

days.title: Protecting the ball
days.work: Practice dribbling while a partner tries to tap the ball away, keeping the body between.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a timed dribble course with both hands and record time.

weeks.assessment: Dribble course time and cue checklist.

objectives: Perform chest, bounce and overhead passes
Shoot using BEEF cues

days.title: Passing
days.work: Practice chest, bounce and overhead passes against a wall, 20 each.

days.title: Form shooting
days.work: Shoot close to the hoop using BEEF cues, 30 shots.

days.title: Layups
days.work: Practice the right-hand layup footwork (right-left-up) slowly, then at speed.

days.title: Shooting game
days.work: Play 'Around the World' at 5 spots.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Evaluate your shooting form on video against BEEF cues and set one fix.

objectives: Use give-and-go and moving to open space
Play person-to-person defense

days.title: Defensive stance
days.work: Practice defensive slides and stance for 5 x 30 seconds.

days.title: Give-and-go
days.work: Practice the give-and-go with a partner and finish with a layup.

days.title: 2-v-1
days.work: Play 2-v-1 drills deciding when to pass or shoot.

days.title: Half-court game
days.work: Play a 2-v-2 half-court game applying offensive and defensive strategies.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Diagram a give-and-go and explain how it creates an open lane.

objectives: Apply skills in a modified game
Demonstrate sportsmanship and rule knowledge

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn traveling, double dribble and fouls and practice calling them fairly.

days.title: Skill stations
days.work: Rotate through dribble, pass and shoot stations as a warm-up, then play 3-on-3.

days.title: Modified game
days.work: Play a modified game where every player must receive a pass before a shot.

days.title: Conflict resolution
days.work: Role-play resolving three common game disputes respectfully.

days.title: Unit 5 assessment
days.work: Complete a basketball skills test (dribble, pass, shoot) and a sportsmanship self-rating.

weeks.assessment: Basketball skills test and sportsmanship self-rating.

weeks.topic: Square dance and line dance basics
objectives: Perform basic square and line dance figures
Respond to calls and rhythm
materials: music for 'Virginia Reel' or a simple square dance and a line dance

days.title: Basic figures
days.work: Learn do-si-do, promenade, swing and allemande with family partners.

days.title: Virginia Reel
days.work: Learn and perform the Virginia Reel (a colonial-era dance tied to HSS).

days.title: Line dance
days.work: Learn grapevine, step-touch and pivot turns in a beginner line dance.

days.title: Calling
days.work: Take turns being the caller and following calls on the beat.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the Virginia Reel and line dance for a family audience.

objectives: Perform folk dances from different cultures
Describe each dance's cultural context
materials: two long sticks or ropes for tinikling
music for the hora and 'La Raspa'

days.title: La Raspa
days.work: Learn the Mexican folk dance 'La Raspa' with its hop-step and elbow swing sections.

days.title: The Hora
days.work: Learn the Israeli hora circle step and dance to music.

days.title: Tinikling
days.work: Learn the Philippine tinikling steps with ropes or sticks on the ground, then with movement.

days.title: Culture connection
days.work: Read about the origins of each dance and share one fact before dancing it.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform two world dances and measure heart rate afterward.

weeks.assessment: World dance performance and cultural fact.

objectives: Design a dance using patterns and formations
Collaborate with others

days.title: Choreography tools
days.work: Learn to vary levels, formations, unison and canon and try each in short phrases.

days.title: Planning
days.work: Plan a 64-count dance with a partner or family member and write the counts.

days.title: Rehearsing
days.work: Rehearse the dance, cleaning up timing and transitions.

days.title: Recording
days.work: Record the dance and revise one section.

days.title: Unit 6 assessment
days.work: Perform the original dance and explain how it uses rhythm and patterns.

objectives: Perform the forearm pass (bump) to a target
Move feet to get under the ball
materials: rope or net between two chairs

days.title: Ready position
days.work: Practice ready position and shuffling to a tossed ball.

days.title: Making a platform
days.work: Practice the forearm platform with self-bumps of a beach ball.

days.title: Partner bumps
days.work: Bump tosses from a partner back to them, counting consecutive good passes.

days.title: Bump to target
days.work: Bump to a hula hoop target from tosses at different heights.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Self-assess bump form with cues (flat platform, legs lift, no swing).

objectives: Perform an overhead set and underhand serve
Sustain a cooperative rally

days.title: Overhead set
days.work: Practice the set with 'triangle hands' using self-sets and partner tosses.

days.title: Underhand serve
days.work: Practice the underhand serve over a rope net from short, then longer distances.

days.title: Cooperative rally
days.work: Rally with a partner over the net using bumps and sets and count your best rally.

days.title: Serve targets
days.work: Serve to marked zones and explain how force and contact point changed placement.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Record serve success rate and best cooperative rally.

weeks.assessment: Serve success rate and rally count.

objectives: Strike with forehand and backhand
Control force to keep a rally
materials: paddles or homemade paddles (paper plates on paint sticks)

days.title: Grip and control
days.work: Learn the shake-hands grip and bounce a ball on the paddle 25 times.

days.title: Forehand
days.work: Hit forehands against a wall above a tape line, counting consecutive hits.

days.title: Backhand
days.work: Practice backhands against the wall and alternate forehand and backhand.

days.title: Partner rally
days.work: Rally with a partner over a low rope, focusing on soft control.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how paddle angle changes the ball's direction and demonstrate.

objectives: Place the ball into open space
Play modified net games safely and fairly

days.title: Placement
days.work: Play a 1-v-1 paddle game scoring only when the ball lands in open space.

days.title: Modified volleyball
days.work: Play 2-v-2 modified volleyball allowing one catch per side.

days.title: Four square
days.work: Play four square with rules about fair calls.

days.title: Strategy talk
days.work: Discuss and write two strategies that won points this week.

days.title: Unit 7 assessment
days.work: Complete a net-game skills test (bump, set, serve, forehand) and a fair-play self-check.

objectives: Bat with correct grip, stance and swing
Hit off a tee and from a soft toss

days.title: Grip and stance
days.work: Learn the batting grip (knuckles aligned) and athletic stance, and practice dry swings.

days.title: Tee hitting
days.work: Hit 30 balls off a tee, aiming for line drives.

days.title: Soft toss
days.work: Hit soft tosses from a partner, tracking the ball to the bat.

days.title: Bat safety
days.work: Review bat safety (safe zone, dropping not throwing the bat) and play a hitting-target game.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Record swing on video and check against batting cues.

objectives: Field ground balls and fly balls
Throw to a base accurately
materials: glove or bare hands with soft ball

days.title: Ground balls
days.work: Field 20 rolled ground balls with 'alligator hands' and get in front of the ball.

days.title: Fly balls
days.work: Catch 20 tossed fly balls using two hands above the head.

days.title: Throwing to bases
days.work: Field and throw to a base target 30 ft away, recording accuracy.

days.title: Relay throws
days.work: Practice a relay throw from outfield to cutoff to base.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a fielding test of 10 grounders and 10 flies.

objectives: Kick a rolled ball for distance and placement
Run bases with correct technique

days.title: Kicking
days.work: Kick rolled balls to left, center and right field on purpose.

days.title: Base running
days.work: Practice running through first base and rounding bases efficiently.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn force outs and tagging up and practice decisions in scenarios.

days.title: Kickball game
days.work: Play a family or neighborhood kickball game.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Diagram where to kick the ball when fielders are positioned in a given way.

weeks.assessment: Kick placement accuracy and strategy diagram.

objectives: Apply batting, fielding and base running in games
Demonstrate sportsmanship in competition

days.title: Hit and run
days.work: Play 'hit the bat and run' where batters run bases while fielders return the ball.

days.title: Modified game
days.work: Play a modified softball game off a tee with everyone batting each inning.

days.title: Fielding positions
days.work: Learn the 9 fielding positions and responsibilities with scenarios.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a full modified game and practice positive talk to teammates.

days.title: Unit 8 assessment
days.work: Complete a striking and fielding skills test and reflect on sportsmanship.

objectives: Explain the FITT principle
Draft a personal fitness plan

days.title: FITT
days.work: Learn the FITT principle and classify 10 activities by type and intensity.

days.title: Reviewing baseline
days.work: Review your baseline FITNESSGRAM scores and choose two goals.

days.title: Drafting a plan
days.work: Draft a 4-week plan using FITT for each goal.

days.title: Activity log
days.work: Start a daily activity log counting minutes of moderate-to-vigorous activity.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Do the first workout of your plan and record it.

objectives: Follow a personal training plan
Monitor intensity using heart rate

days.title: Interval run
days.work: Do a 20-minute interval run (1 min jog, 1 min walk) and check heart rate.

days.title: Strength circuit
days.work: Complete a 3-round strength circuit targeting curl-ups and push-ups.

days.title: Active game
days.work: Play a vigorous game (capture the flag) for 20 minutes.

days.title: Flexibility and core
days.work: Complete a yoga flow and trunk lift practice.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Review the activity log and rate effort for each day.

objectives: Explain how hydration and nutrition support activity
Practice recovery strategies

days.title: Hydration
days.work: Learn signs of dehydration and track water intake around a 30-minute workout.

days.title: Fuel for activity
days.work: Plan a pre-activity snack and post-activity snack and explain the choices.

days.title: Recovery
days.work: Practice a full cool-down and foam-roll or stretching routine.

days.title: Practice test
days.work: Do a practice round of the PACER and curl-ups to check progress.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write how hydration and food affected your energy this week.

objectives: Complete post-assessment fitness tests
Compare results to baseline

days.title: Aerobic test
days.work: Complete the PACER or mile run post-test.

days.title: Strength tests
days.work: Complete curl-up and push-up post-tests.

days.title: Flexibility tests
days.work: Complete trunk lift and sit-and-reach post-tests.

days.title: Comparing results
days.work: Graph baseline vs. post-test results and identify improvements.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write whether you met your goals and why.

weeks.topic: Summer activity plan and field day
objectives: Create a summer activity plan
Lead and participate in a field day
materials: field day equipment (ropes, balls, cones, sacks)

days.title: Summer plan
days.work: Create a summer activity plan with weekly goals and favorite activities.

days.title: Field day planning
days.work: Plan 6 field day stations using skills from this year.

days.title: Field day
days.work: Host a family or co-op field day, leading the stations and encouraging others.

days.title: Lifetime activities
